prompt: Convert the cell biology notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/cell-biology-notes.md, analyze all the biological concepts, definitions, organelles, and processes described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards that covers all the key information, choosing the appropriate card type for each piece of information according to the decision tree. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/cell-biology-notes-flashcards.md.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 20 flashcards

assertions.name: has_concept_cards
assertions.description: Contains at least 5 Concept cards (::) for named cell structures like mitochondria, nucleus, cell membrane

assertions.name: has_descriptor_cards
assertions.description: Contains at least 3 Descriptor cards (;;) for attributes of major concepts

assertions.name: has_cloze_cards
assertions.description: Contains at least 2 Cloze cards ({{ }}) for facts embedded in sentences

assertions.name: has_variety_of_types
assertions.description: Uses at least 4 different card types (Concept, Descriptor, Cloze, Basic, Multi-Line)

assertions.name: no_image_occlusion
assertions.description: Contains no image occlusion syntax (no image references or visual markup)

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments, metadata, or annotations - only flashcard syntax

assertions.name: covers_key_concepts
assertions.description: Includes flashcards for: cell membrane, mitochondria, nucleus, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, ribosomes, lysosomes, cytoskeleton, cell division
